instruction: Change the title text color to blue.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the title text color from black (0, 0, 0) to blue. Using standard blue RGB (0, 0, 255) with tolerance of 20 to allow for theme variations. The getter extracts RGB color from title text, and the metric checks if it matches blue within tolerance.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Getter hardcodes search for 'Neural Network' text (line 29) instead of finding the title shape generically. This makes verification brittle and file-specific.
The instruction says 'Change the title text color' without specifying text content. The getter should use slide.shapes.title or find title placeholder, not search for specific text.
RGB type mismatch: python-pptx's run.font.color.rgb returns RGBColor object, not tuple. Metric expects tuple (r, g, b) for unpacking at line 22, which may cause runtime error.
Getter returns None if 'Neural Network' text not found or if shape doesn't match conditions, making verification fail even if title color was changed correctly.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Replace text search with generic title detection: Use 'if slide.shapes.title:' or check for title placeholder type instead of searching for 'Neural Network'.
Fix RGB extraction: Convert RGBColor to tuple with '(run.font.color.rgb.r, run.font.color.rgb.g, run.font.color.rgb.b)' or use proper unpacking.
Remove hardcoded text condition 'len(shape.text) < 20' which is arbitrary and unnecessary for title detection.
Add better error handling for cases where title shape doesn't exist or has no text formatting.
